metadata.scenario: A new customer calls questioning a recent bill that includes charges they don't recognize and insists these are incorrect. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Mark Johnson. I'm calling about a bill I received that I don't understand. I'm sorry to hear that, Mark. Can you provide me with your account details or the bill number? Yes, it's account number 4572. The bill includes charges for services I don't recognize. Thank you for that information. What specific charges are you referring to? There’s a $95 charge for medication management that I didn’t authorize. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your file and review the details. Okay, but I just want to make sure these charges are accurate. I only agreed to personal care assistance. I appreciate your patience, Mark. I see that you also scheduled medication management last month. I didn’t authorize that. I just need someone to help my parents with their medications. I understand. It appears there was some miscommunication. Yes, I definitely want to get this sorted out. I can help with that. Would you like to discuss our services to assist your parents? Sure, but I really want to fix this billing issue first. Absolutely, let me take notes on this billing dispute. I’ll connect with our billing department today. Thank you. I’d appreciate a quick resolution. I can definitely follow up with you by tomorrow. What’s the best number to reach you at? You can reach me at +13165555832. Great! I’ll ensure someone contacts you with an update. And about the services, what do you offer for medication management? Our medication management service is $65 to $80, depending on the complexity. It includes reminders and supervision. That sounds good. Maybe I’d like to schedule that after we sort this out. Absolutely, I’ll note that as a follow-up action item as well. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Mark. Thank you for your understanding. I'll be waiting for your call. We’ll be in touch soon. Have a great day! You too, goodbye!
